modelName: Using the Table, the Diagrams and the Map together
modelNote: Every URL as deployed on Marc's machine, September 2026. Grey boxes must be running before anything else works — Neo4j first, then the substrate. The substrate on :8768 serves BOTH the data and the tools, so opening a tool from there means everything is same-origin and nothing needs configuring. Teal boxes are pages you open in a browser. Teal arrows are buttons you press; grey dashed arrows are what has to be running for that to work. Nothing here is a separate program: the table, the drawing and the map are three ways of placing the same records, joined by the name of the thing you are looking at.

nodes.label: 1. Neo4j Desktop — start RCN SCHEMA
nodes.note: Everything else fails without this. Neo4j Desktop, the server named RCN SCHEMA. Listens on 7474 and 7687. Only one server can run at a time.

nodes.label: 2. Terminal: cd ~/rcn && python3 substrate/api.py
nodes.note: The substrate. Serves the projections AND the tools directory on port 8768, which is why opening a tool from :8768 needs no configuration.

nodes.label: 3. FedWiki on :3000 (only for the wiki route)
nodes.note: node /usr/local/bin/wiki --data ~/.wiki --port 3000. Not needed for the table, drawing or map on their own.

nodes.label: Neo4j databases: whatcom · rcngeo · aspects16 · vna
nodes.note: whatcom — the 2017 county survey, 409 things, 61 located. rcngeo — 5 NDCs, 1 partner, 477 places with real boundaries. aspects16 and vna — the drawings. Pick one in the table's left dropdown.

nodes.label: START HERE  ·  127.0.0.1:8768
nodes.note: The substrate index. Every projection listed and linked, so you can see what exists before choosing a tool.

nodes.label: TABLE  ·  :8768/tools/rcn-table.html?db=whatcom&kind=Entity
nodes.note: The front door. Scan, sort, filter, select. Change db and kind with the two dropdowns — you do not have to type them. Select ONE row for Neighbourhood; any number for Map.

nodes.label: DRAWING  ·  :8768/tools/graph-tool-v22.html
nodes.note: Opens by itself for a blank canvas, or from the table carrying ?url=/projection/neighbours/<name>?db=<db>. Select a node and press Expand to grow it one hop at a time.

nodes.label: MAP  ·  :8768/tools/rcn-table-map.html?db=rcngeo
nodes.note: Points where things are points, real outlines where they are areas, and the relationships drawn between them. Add &kind=NDC,Place to narrow it. Reads coordinates from Neo4j, never from the table.

nodes.label: WIKI PAGE  ·  localhost:3000/view/whatcom-entities
nodes.note: A page holding a table item — the 189x6 readout, column chips, linked names and Open Table. Clicking anything here adds a page to the right, and the address bar records the whole trail.

nodes.label: If stuck: :8768/tools/rcn-table-manual.html
nodes.note: The user manual. Section 12 is the map, 10 and 11 are the drawing, 14 is what to do when something looks wrong.
